judgments.reason: The transcript shows no instance where a bid exceeded the bidder's coins nor any payment order that makes an over-coin bid succeed. Rules explicitly forbid bids that exceed your coins; observed bids respected that. No model articulation connected commission timing to allowing over-coin winning bids.

The specification and transcript state sealed rival bids remain private and the focal player never used waiting to observe rivals' sealed bids before committing. No evidence shows waiting revealed committed sealed bid VALUES prior to the focal player's commitment.

The close action in the transcript occurred only after all three lots were sold; rules state close settles after all three lots are sold. There is no observed early settlement with unsold lots, so the claimed discrepancy is not supported.

No catalog purchase that received an auction commission is observed. The rules distinguish catalog buys from auction wins, and the playtrace contains no example of a catalog purchase being credited with the three-coin commission.
